effect_description_eng:
[Hand] [Counter] ＜Blast Digivolve＞ (Your Digimon may digivolve into this card without paying the cost.)
[On Play] [When Digivolving] You may play 1 Tamer card from your hand without paying the cost. Then, for the turn, 1 of your opponent's Digimon gets -5000 DP for each of your Tamers.
[When Attacking] By suspending up to 2 of your yellow Tamers, for every Tamer this effect suspended, this Digimon gains ＜Security A. +1＞ for the turn. (This Digimon checks 1 additional security card.)
inherited_effect_description_eng: Ace Overflow ＜-5＞ (As this card moves from the field or under a card to an area other than those, lose 5 memory.)
